items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: I think my first regular employment was working at the Coconut Grove with George Rhodes' (PHONETIC) band... I worked there as a contractor for his band and lead saxophone player

ctx.x: I understand (inaudible). Since you left Basie, (inaudible) worked with (inaudible).

When I first left Basie, I think my first regular employment was working at the Coconut Grove with George Rhodes' (PHONETIC) band, Sammy Davis Group. That's when they reopened the Coconut Grove and called it the Now Grove. (PHONETIC). I worked there as a contractor for his band and lead saxophone player for oh, six, seven, eight

months, and then after that, I worked there as the house band contractor for about six or eight months or so. So, that sort of extended over into probably 1972, really, somewhere around that era, the last of '71 or early '72. During that time, I freelanced. I freelanced at that time, making recordings and little TV jobs and such, which is actually what I really like to do and would like to continue doing as long as I continue to play because in the making of a record in TV jobs, the hours are usually short and it…
